A/book.png: round back and more buttons at top corners, one filled Start Session with tinted secondaries; all 34 measured text nodes pass

B/book.png: Middlemarch quotation set in serif at reading size with generous leading, page and chapter below in SF

C/today.png: Sunday bar hatched to mark in progress, Wed shown as a flat 0, chart labelled 'minutes · goal line at 20'; in-progress status is not by colour alone

pairs.reason: C keeps every target at 44 pt and its tab bar clear of the home indicator; B's small Log capsules and low tab bar miss both.
C marks Sunday in progress with a pattern, lists all three books with their last session, and its empty state explains the app; A compresses two books.
A's floating tab bar sits above the home indicator and its Today targets are full size; B has sub-44 Log buttons and a tab bar in the bottom inset.

notes: All three use iOS 26 patterns: large title, inset floating tab bar with separate Search, round glass nav buttons. None uses Material patterns or a bezel. The only measured contrast failure is C's decorative cover microtext. Differences on platform come down to targets, bottom-inset placement and how in-progress and below-goal status are encoded.
